newsitem.title: USA: Turbine at Hoover dam shut, but power not affected.
newsitem.headline: Turbine at Hoover dam shut, but power not affected.

text.p: A power turbine at the Hoover Dam in Nevada is currently shut for scheduled maintenance but power generation from the dam has not been affected, according to the U.S. Bureau of Reclamation.
"We have enough other generators to accomodate the water coming out now," said the project manager at the dam.
He noted that the primary objective of the Hoover project is to supply water to the Southwest, with power generation a by-product of that activity.
"After October 1 we are getting into lower demand for water, as well as power," the manager explained. "If there is no need for the water downstream, we don't run it through the turbines."
The Hoover dam has a power generation capacity of 2,078 megawatts, but typically produces well below that level, according to the Bureau of Reclamation's power resources division.
